03-violin-plot-orchestra.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol Bright palette and clear typographic hierarchy show real design intent, but Singapore's near-zero seasonal spread collapses its violins into illegible horizontal slivers — a hard perceptual failure for an entire row.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.encoding_integrity_note: Shared y-scale domain derived from d3.extent, violinScale uses data-driven maxDensity, Silverman bandwidth for KDE, and linear width encoding is correct for violin density — no lie factor, no truncated baseline, no dual-axis abuse; minor deduction for synthetic data and no key functions on static join.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.stress_test_note: Static hover-only visualization with no brush/zoom/transitions; uses unified Pointer Events API eliminating mouse-touch fight risk, and all closures capture immutable render-time values.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.cognitive_load_note: 72 cells (6 cities × 12 months) sounds large but function as true small multiples — shared y-scale, consistent split-violin encoding, just 2 colors, and alternating row bands guide the eye so the seasonal gradient across rows reads as a single coherent pattern rather than 72 independent items to track.
